description: The UNaLab deposit compares rainfall retention by resin-bound gravel and meadow surfaces at Gavoglio in Genova. This resource is provided by UNaLab. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists XLSX formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The observations describe a local demonstration and do not establish performance for other soils or climates. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epa-swmm. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
name: Genova - Stormwater retention capacity
